tagline.en: Free daily brain games: a fresh set of word, logic, number and spatial puzzles every day. Play any 3 of the 19 free, no account needed.
tagline.zh-Hant: 免費每日腦力遊戲：每天一套全新的文字、邏輯、數字及空間謎題。19 款之中任選 3 款免費玩，毋須註冊。

source.note: Runs on Sylphx: services declared in the repository root sylphx.toml (web and api services, the database and its migrations, Sylphx Auth sign-in). Formerly Puzzled; its old pages here redirect to tryit.fun (nginx.conf).
